title: A fixed set of must-teach quotations
statement: In a literature unit, fix a set of must-teach quotations, mark them in the reading text, and build each lesson's guided practice on them.
detail: The Grade 9 unit's reading texts mark its must-teach quotations, which it calls store-cupboard quotes, in red bold (`g9/sources/Act 1 reading texts/Act 1/1. 1.1 - Iago_s Introduction - Text.docx`, line 3). A later lesson build's knowledge organiser says its red quotes are each lesson's guided practice quotes and glosses each one as must-know evidence for the unit (`g9/sources/Othello Act 2 Lesson.html`, line 382). No outcome was measured.
